limitations: Finite coordinate search and one fixed Main sample, not an exhaustive search.
Full Main chooses among retained layer-sweep states; sample gains may not generalize.
Full-Main IoU and sample balanced-IoU objectives differ, so sample/full-Main loss is not proof of overfitting alone.
Groups start from sampled shared fit final, not the full-Main-selected historical shared control. Channels start from corresponding group fit final.
Four channel branches selected their group initialization under IoU policy; do not attribute these results to added channel degrees of freedom.
Dev has been repeatedly used for development; no Validation/Test/HW-calibration access.
Different per-channel theta requires additional decoded bucket multiplication/addition, not rescaled synaptic weights.
Neural equivalent MAC/AC are not measured energy or full pipeline cost.

conclusion.r1_group_joint_tradeoff: Recall/HD recall above ANN, but lower IoU and precision; slightly lower AC than historical task_rescore.
conclusion.r2_grouped_tradeoff: At most +0.145364 pp observed IoU vs original uncalibrated T8, with lower recall and +8.358753% AC; below epoch88 and direction5 best.
conclusion.channel_evidence: Every channel IoU-policy branch falls back to its group start. Actual channel-m0 recall-policy points improve recall at substantial precision/IoU cost.
conclusion.next: Retain all candidates; stop expanding this finite calibration configuration. Keep original ANN and historical best. A future compute-oriented experiment should be a separately authorized direction6 paired AC-regularization trial, not additional training of this calibration version.
